title: Decode xz's stderr before interpolating it in seed_content_db.dart's failure message (currently prints a raw byte list)
why: Process.runSync is called at line 312-317 with `stderrEncoding: null`, so ProcessResult.stderr holds raw bytes (a Uint8List), not a decoded String. String-interpolating it at line 319 invokes List.toString(), producing something like 'xz failed: [120, 122, 58, 32, ...]' instead of xz's actual human-readable stderr text — exactly when a maintainer most needs a readable error, during a failing release build.
recommendation: Pass `stderrEncoding: systemEncoding` (or explicit `utf8`) to this Process.runSync call, or explicitly `utf8.decode(xzResult.stderr as List<int>)` before interpolating it into the thrown StateError.
acceptance_criteria: Triggering an xz failure (e.g. temporarily pointing dbPath at a nonexistent file, or aliasing xz unavailable) prints a human-readable message, not a numeric byte-list
seed_content_db.dart's xz Process.runSync call sets stderrEncoding to a real Encoding, or decodes stderr before use
